quick_start.input_format: One industrial carrier establishes scale and inventory. + The external medium causes every displacement. + Interior reactions match the same force direction. + Geography remains recoverable across exterior and interior cuts. + The final shore state preserves a visible consequence and source carrier.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one autonomous ice freighter crossing a narrow meltwater channel with white cargo pods registered on deck. Cut inside to one adult route controller as a compass cup and hanging chart swing in the same direction. End with one pod wedged against an empty service cradle while water drains and the original freighter remains visible offshore.
